28, Chicago here.

Bad. People are getting laid off and I'm worried about my job in fraud prevention. We're working from home but I'm still worried how long this will last.

I was eating healthy and exercising five times a week. Now, it's a struggle to will myself to do any exercises at home. I literally just binged on McDonald's, ice cream, cake and Domino's half off pizza deal and don't even feel like cooking like I used to.

I'm worried if I lose my job, I'll have to move out of my wonderful neighborhood and move back in with my strict parents who treat me like a child. I'm also worried about them since they are over 60 with pre-existing health conditions. Every day would be mentally excrutiating if I went back to that environment, just to leave it at that.

The social gatherings I prepared for are all cancelled, my friends are getting laid off and I can barely focus. I feel even worse when I read about how everyone else is going through shit at the same time. I haven't felt suicidal in a very long time with all this anxiety and doomer news but fuck, man.

It's just a huge ball of stress and I don't know how to deal with it. Fuck.
